name: Homeward Stone (Kingdom)
description: A smooth grey stone set with a crown rune in royal blue, registered in the Crown's ledger. Hold it, think of the Kingdom's square, and the waystone there pulls you home.
notes: Use it to teleport to the waystone in the Kingdom's town square. It isn't used up.
All Homeward Stones share one charge: after any of them carries you, none works for a week.
Not in a fight, a dungeon or a party. Using one on the road abandons the trip. No time passes.
Sold by the vault keeper in the Kingdom.
